info.title: Kiorex Passport account management API
info.description: Self-service account routes of Kiorex Passport (repo kiorex-account, dev IdP in apps/dev-idp; the managed IdP in AWS exposes the same contract). Bearer access token issued by Passport for a Passport client; the caller is always the subject of the token. Operator routes (/api/ops/*) and the OIDC, OTP and SCIM endpoints are not part of this document. Status: As-built for the dev IdP; the drift test (apps/dev-idp/test/openapi-drift.test.ts) fails when a route is added or removed without this file.

get.summary: The signed-in account profile, MFA state and the authentication context of the token

delete.summary: Delete the account (KA-07): sessions and grants revoked, back-channel subject.deleted sent

403.description: step_up_required: repeat after POST /api/step-up (acr_values and max_age in the body)

get.summary: Export of identity data (KA-07). Never clinical data (ADR-013)
Apps that hold a grant for the account

delete.summary: Withdraw an app's access (409 cannot_revoke_current_app for the app the token belongs to)

post.summary: Create a dependant (a guardian link awaits verification)

post.summary: Send a six-digit code to the address (mock e-mail channel until the provider go-live); 429 email_code_resend_too_soon, 409 email_in_use

delete.summary: Remove the address and the verified flag

post.summary: Return the code: email_verified becomes true (the email and email_verified claims then appear in access tokens of clients that ask for the email scope); 5 attempts per code

get.summary: Linked upstream identities and the upstreams available
Account link requests of the caller

post.summary: Ask to link a second account (a code goes to the other number); accounts are never merged automatically
Verify the code; the link then awaits operator review

get.summary: Policy the UI needs: passkeys flag, guardianship, organisations, step-up, MFA roles

post.summary: Create an organisation (the caller becomes owner)

get.summary: SCIM tokens of an organisation (owner or admin)

post.summary: Create a SCIM bearer token (shown once)

get.summary: Registered passkeys (404 feature_disabled while account.passkeys is off)
The caller's own security events (never other subjects, never raw phone numbers)
Active sessions with the current one marked

delete.summary: Revoke every session except the current one
Revoke one session (back-channel logout sent to its clients)

post.summary: Prove a second factor (totp or passkey); answers a fresh access token with the MFA acr
WebAuthn assertion options for a step-up

get.summary: Freshness window, sensitive actions and the MFA acr value
TOTP enrolment state and whether MFA is required for this account

post.summary: Start TOTP enrolment (secret and otpauth URI, shown once); 409 already_enrolled

get.summary: Workspaces the caller can enter (organisation memberships with edition)
